name: basecamp

scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-test --only firestore,auth 'vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.js'
scripts.deploy:checks: npm ci && npm test && npm run test:integration
scripts.deploy:dev: node scripts/check-dev-env.mjs && npm run deploy:checks && npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules,firestore:indexes --project dev
scripts.deploy:prod: node scripts/check-prod-env.mjs && npm run deploy:checks && npm run build:prod && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules,firestore:indexes --project prod
scripts.deploy: echo 'Use deploy:dev or deploy:prod explicitly' && exit 1

_overridesNote: protobufjs pinned to fix GHSA-j3f2-48v5-ccww (DoS via infinite loop in .proto option parsing). Transitive dependency: firebase → @firebase/firestore → @grpc/proto-loader. Can be removed once @grpc/proto-loader requires protobufjs>=7.6.5. Verify with: npm ls protobufjs. uuid pinned to fix GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (missing buffer bounds check). Transitive dependency: firebase-admin → @google-cloud/storage → gaxios/teeny-request. Can be removed once Google Cloud SDK updates uuid. nanoid pinned to fix GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8 (custom generators can loop indefinitely when size is zero). Transitive dependency: postcss → nanoid. Can be removed once postcss requires nanoid>=3.3.17. Verify with: npm ls nanoid. undici pinned to fix GHSA-4cwx-7wf7-3272 (cross-user information disclosure and parse-time crash via degenerate private cache directives). Transitive dependency: jsdom → undici. Can be removed once jsdom requires undici>=7.29.0. Verify with: npm ls undici.
